name: Yasons Chemex Care Ltd.
summary: Yasons Chemex Care Ltd. is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and trading of dyes, intermediates, and various chemicals, alongside a Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) product line. The company manufactures and trades a broad range of dyestuffs, including reactive, direct, basic, vat, food colorants, natural, synthetic, and synthetic organic dyes. Its chemical and intermediate offerings include products like tobias acid, beta naphthol sulpho, LR grade ammonium sulphate, sodium petroleum sulfonate, and BP grade glycerine, as well as emulsifiers, surfactant products, and fine pigment dispersions/emulsions. These products primarily serve diverse industrial sectors such as textile and garment, water treatment, laminate, agrochemicals, adhesives, metal, paper, paints, inks, soap, plastic, wood, and detergents. In its FMCG segment, Yasons Chemex Care Ltd. manufactures and markets products like hair oil, perfumes, deodorants, handmade soap, sanitizers, and toners under its proprietary brand "PLXO". The company operates two manufacturing facilities located in Gujarat, India; one for dyes and pigment paste in Vatva, Ahmedabad, and another for FMCG products in Sanand District, Ahmedabad. Yasons Chemex Care Ltd. is a subsidiary of Yash Chemex Limited.
